card.name: Stop or resume verbs in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Action verbs such as resume, stop, or the noun adjustment that open an instruction about holding, restarting, or changing a drug. Also the word Summary after Pregnancy Risk.

modes.label: Stop/resume verb
modes.description: Verb telling the reader to stop, withhold, or resume a drug after a condition or intervention label.
modes.example: Intervention : Temporarily<< stop>> naproxen and esomeprazole

modes.label: Dosage adjustment
modes.description: The word adjustment after dosage in statements about changing the dose.
modes.example: No dosage<< adjustment>> is necessary for patients with renal failure.

modes.label: Pregnancy Risk Summary
modes.description: The word Summary in the Pregnancy Risk Summary heading.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted words are mostly unrelated to the contexts (Relax, Luck).
card.plain: It lights up on the verb that tells you to stop or restart a drug, such as stop or resume.
